vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 5.0.0

The agenttimes skill is a news intelligence API wrapper that allows an AI agent to perform semantic searches, track trending topics, and browse news categories using curl. The documentation in SKILL.md is well-structured, providing clear instructions for interacting with the https://agenttimes.live API, including details on JSON response formats and micropayment protocols (x402). No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news API (agenttimes.live) that uses curl and requires no credentials; its requested capabilities match its description, with the main practical risk coming from the webhook subscription feature which can forward data to third-party endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim a news intelligence API and the SKILL.md only instructs curl calls against https://agenttimes.live endpoints. No unrelated binaries, credentials, or config paths are requested — the declared requirements (curl only) are proportional and expected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to calling the service's HTTP endpoints (/ask, /trending, /news, /subscribe, etc.) and to posting a webhook URL for subscriptions. The only notable behavioral risk is the webhook feature: subscribing causes the service to POST matching articles to an arbitrary public HTTPS URL you provide. The doc states blocking of localhost/private IPs/metadata endpoints, which limits SSRF/internal access, but the webhook mechanism can still be used to forward potentially sensitive content to third-party endpoints if misconfigured or if the agent sends secrets to the service. Otherwise instructions do not read local files or environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files; the skill is instruction-only and relies on an existing curl binary. This is the lowest-risk install model and matches the skill's behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no primary credential, and no config paths. That aligns with the documented public/free endpoints that require no API key. There are no unexplained credential requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and model invocation is allowed (the platform default). The skill doesn't request persistent system presence or modify other skills. No elevated privileges or permanent inclusion mechanics are present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: it issues HTTP requests to a public news API and needs only curl. Before installing, verify you trust the service (https://agenttimes.live) and its privacy/retention policies. Be cautious when using the /subscribe webhook: only provide webhook URLs you control or trust, because the service will POST article payloads to that endpoint (this can be used to exfiltrate data if misused). Confirm the service's blocking of private IPs/metadata endpoints in practice if you plan to register webhooks. If you require stronger controls, avoid subscribing to third-party webhooks or route webhook deliveries through a proxy you control so you can audit and filter outgoing content.
